work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act empowers Bishop Florens, vicar apostolic of Siam, to choose and consecrate a coadjutor with succession. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF8836; own dating clause LF8943–8946 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Mariam Maiorem sub annulo piscatoris die nona septembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo primo, pontificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF8949 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
